blocks.text: SEOUL — South Korea said it deployed fighter jets and conducted tactical maneuvers after several Russian military aircraft entered its air defense zone on Tuesday. The Joint Chiefs of Staff (JCS) in Seoul said an unspecified number of Russian aircraft entered and later exited the Korea Air Defense Identification Zone (KADIZ) over the East Sea, also known as the Sea of Japan, in the early hours of Tuesday. “Our military detected the Russian aircraft before they entered the KADIZ and deployed Air Force fighter jets, taking tactical measures to prepare for any contingency,” the JCS said in a brief statement.
